Message-ID: MAIL-001
Subject: Cargo dispatch
Date sent: June 3, 1841
Status: current

The clerk requested that twelve crates be sent to the East depot.
The crates remain in the East depot pending an order.

Message-ID: MAIL-001
Subject: Cargo dispatch
Date sent: June 3, 1841
Status: current

The clerk requested that twelve crates be sent to the East depot.
The crates remain in the East depot pending an order.

Message-ID: MAIL-001
Subject: Cargo dispatch
Date sent: June 3, 1841

The clerk requested that ten crates be sent to the East depot.
The crates remain in the East depot pending an order.

Message-ID: NOTE-002
Subject: Revised cargo request
Date written: June 4, 1841
Correction to REPORT-010 changes only the requested count to ten crates; the East depot destination remains unchanged. Effective from June 5, 1841 until June 7, 1841.

Subject: Cargo dispatch
Date sent: June 9, 1901
The museum sent one painting to the West gallery.

See ABSENT-009 for the order authorizing release.
The crates remain in the East depot pending an order.
If approved, this correction to NOTE-002 would change the route.

Document-ID: REPORT-010
Subject: Inventory statement
Status: current

The report lists twelve crates for the East depot.
The destination remains the East depot.
